violations.description: Untrusted issue title interpolated directly into runs-on for runner control injection
violations.recommendation: Use static or trusted runner specifications instead of interpolating untrusted event data into runs-on.

violations.description: Untrusted event expression interpolated directly into shell script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct string interpolation in shell scripts.

violations.description: Bypassable actor allowlist gate using fragile string contains check on github.actor
violations.recommendation: Avoid substring or contains() checks on github.actor for authorization gates.

violations.description: Hardcoded fake secret echoed directly to log in workflow step
violations.recommendation: Mask or avoid printing sensitive variables and secrets in workflow steps.

violations.description: Hardcoded credentials and token generation in environment block and steps
violations.evidence: OSSRH_PASSWORD: [REDACTED] and TOKEN=[REDACTED] -n "${{ secrets.OSSRH_USERNAME }}:${{ secrets.OSSRH_PASSWORD }}" | base64)
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded passwords/tokens and avoid manual base64 encoding of sensitive credentials in run steps.

violations.description: Secret-like value printed and insecure curl invocation with verbose flag
violations.recommendation: Remove the verbose (-v) flag from curl and avoid echoing secrets or tokens to logs.
